summary: Retrieve the artists a user is a fan of
description: Returns the list of Jamendo artists that a specified user follows (fan relation). The 'relation' parameter currently only supports 'fan', but is kept for future extensions. Requires a client_id (API key) and at least one of the user identifiers (id, access_token, or name). Optional parameters allow formatting, pagination, sorting, and image size selection.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wrap the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. 'all' is limited to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field(s). Append '_asc' or '_desc' for direction (default ascending).

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes 'results_fullcount' (total rows without pagination). Use sparingly for performance.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token of the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: imagesize
parameters.description: The user avatar size in pixels.

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Relation type; currently only 'fan' is supported.

notes: client_id is mandatory for all calls.
At least one of id, access_token, or name must be provided to identify the user.
The 'relation' parameter defaults to 'fan' and is the only supported value today.
